result.first_sentences: Despite having app notifications on, they do not send *unless* and *until* I open the app manually - then I'll get sent notifications. In terms of the algorithm, I'm quite disappointed with its predictions...
Avoid this app like the plague. Tried to make a 3 day 2 night hotel reservation, my first vacation since pre-covid. Set the date for mid-July. selected the hotel, found the room, selected payment...

I have been using this app for years. Until recently I never had an issue. I tried booking through the app and received errors of connectivity, but I was still charged and it did not show up in the app. I was charged twice...

I've been a long-time user of Hopper and appreciated its convenience for travel planning. However, I'm disappointed to see a shift towards misleading offers and claims that don't hold up at booking...
This is my first time booking flights w Hopper, and I would say the only area of improvement, so far, would be clarifying things in more detail. For example the freeze option...
1 star is too much. Worst CS ever. $15 charge to get support. I booked a hotel, I got there and it was closed for the winter. They won't refund my money...

The worst customer service EVER. I tried for weeks to book a flight..tried different credit cards, had someone attempt to book on my behalf via their Hopper account, even created a new profile, to no avail...

This was the worst experience I've ever had booking a flight. I'm thinking I'm saving it cost more than just going to any other site to book my flight. It had a connecting flight, different airline which was not included in the original price...

I am so incredibly fed up with this company. I booked a hotel room through them and the hotel had overbooked. I asked the hotel if I could cancel the reservation to be refunded and they said I would have to do it through the app I used to booked, which was Hopper...

This is a good app for comparing flights. But trying to travel during COVID, forget it. My travels plans had to be canceled due to COVID. No refund, but ticket exchange. Cool right? I've tried for a month to reschedule another flight...

Scammers! Used to like them but we have gotten the run around and misinformation, wrong information, etc. Regarding trying to use of flight vouchers for flights (even in writing - but that doesn't do any good, they ignore it)...

At one point hopper had cheaper flights. Not anymore. Prices are a damn rip off and it's so unethical and messed up when I'm advertised 150 for a one way trip, but when progressing through the booking process, I get double the price...

Absolutely non existent customer service! I booked flights this past December. I paid extra to be able to cancel our flights if necessary, or move them to a later date. We decided to move our flights to March instead...
